title: Broccoli Cheddar Baked Potatoes
description: Fluffy baked potatoes topped with broccoli and cheddar.

ingredients.item: plain Greek yogurt or sour cream

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Pierce 4 potatoes with a fork and place on a sheet pan.
Bake potatoes about 45–50 minutes, until easily pierced with a knife.
Microwave 3 cups broccoli with a splash of water 3–4 minutes until tender; drain.
Split potatoes and top with broccoli, 1 1/2 cups cheddar, and 1/2 cup Greek yogurt or sour cream.

title: Quick Tuna Melt Toasts
description: Hot cheesy tuna melts made on toast in minutes.

steps.text: Heat broiler. Mix 1 can drained tuna with 2 tablespoons mayonnaise and 1 teaspoon mustard.
Put 4 bread slices on a baking sheet and divide the tuna mixture over them.
Broil 2–4 minutes, watching closely, until cheese bubbles and edges are crisp.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
description: No-cook oats with banana and peanut butter for an easy breakfast.

steps.text: Divide 1 cup rolled oats between 2 containers.
Stir in 1 cup milk, 1 mashed banana, and 2 tablespoons peanut butter.
Add 1 tablespoon maple syrup if you want it sweeter.
Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.

title: Cinnamon French Toast
description: Classic skillet French toast with cinnamon and vanilla.

steps.text: Whisk 3 eggs, 3/4 cup milk, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and 1 teaspoon vanilla in a shallow bowl.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip 8 bread slices briefly in the egg mixture, then cook in batches 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
